description: Summary of a data access request

requestId.description: Id of the data access request

accessRequirementId.description: Id of the related access requirement

accessRequirementName.description: Name of the related access requirement

isEDuc.description: True if the request uses the eDUC flow

signaturesRequested.description: The number of signers requested for the eDUC, or null if using non-eDUC flow

signaturesAcquired.description: The number of signers who have signed the eDUC, or null if using non-eDUC flow

submittedOn.description: Date/time the request was submitted, or null if not yet submitted

modifiedOn.description: Date/time the request was last modified

expiresOn.description: Date/time when the access approval expires, or null if no approval exists for this user
